question: Does a losing streak hurt the next round beyond economy (the no-timeout baseline)?
answer: No tilt. After 3+ straight losses a team wins +0.9 pp vs an economy and score model.
findings: After 1 loss in a row: wins 35.8%, model 36.3%, gap -0.4 pp (-0.7 to -0.2 pp, n=136,681).
After 3 losses in a row: wins 39.5%, model 38.5%, gap +1.1 pp (+0.7 to +1.5 pp, n=51,700).
After 5 losses in a row: wins 40.8%, model 40.0%, gap +0.8 pp (+0.1 to +1.6 pp, n=15,367).
bo3.gg round data has no timeout calls, so the timeout effect itself is not measured.
method: Logistic baseline on buy-class matchup by side, equipment values, score gap, Elo and round in half; actual minus predicted win rate by current losing streak in the half, map-clustered CIs.
data: bo3.gg round data, S/A/B-tier pro maps, 2023-10-16 to 2026-11-02, 17,525 maps, 327,073 rounds
split_check: 3+ streak gap: early +0.9 pp (n=55,017), late +0.9 pp (n=55,026).

chart.title: Next-round win vs economy model, by losing streak
